chunks: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Masroor (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Al-Hussein ibn Muhammad ibn Amer, from Ma'la ibn Muhammad al-Basri, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanty, from Ali ibn Ja'far, who said: I heard Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon them) say:

While the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) was sitting, an angel with twenty-four faces entered upon him. The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said to him: 'My friend Gabriel, I have not seen you in such a form?' The angel said: 'I am not Gabriel; I am Mahmood. God, the Exalted, sent me to unite light with light.' He asked: 'Who? Who?' He replied: 'Fatimah (peace be upon her) from Ali.' When the angel turned away, it was written between his shoulders: 'Muhammad is the Messenger of God, Ali is his Trustee.' The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) asked: 'Since when has this been between your shoulders?' He said: 'Before God, the Exalted, created Adam by twenty-four thousand years.'

key_terms.آدَمَ: Adam (the first human, used as a temporal marker)
key_terms.النُّورَ مِنَ النُّورِ: Light from light (spiritual union of the Imams)
key_terms.بَيْنَ كَتِفَيْهِ: Between his shoulders (location of the inscription)
key_terms.مَحْمُودٌ: Mahmood (a specific angel mentioned in this narration)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the angel Mahmood and the pre-creation of Fatimah and Ali's union in Shia theology?
ai.summary: In this mystical hadith from *Al-Khisal*, the angel Mahmood appears to the Prophet with twenty-four faces to announce the spiritual marriage of light between Fatimah and Ali, distinct from the usual Gabriel narrative. The inscription of their union on the angel's shoulders, dating back twenty-four thousand years before Adam's creation, underscores the pre-existence of the Ahl al-Bayt's spiritual reality in Shia theology. This event highlights the cosmic significance of the Prophet's progeny and their eternal status as the 'Light of God' within the divine plan.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 28-7 Ja’far ibn Muhammad ibn Masroor - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Al-Hussein ibn Muhammad ibn Amer quoted Al-Mo’ali ibn Muhammad al-Basry, on the authority of Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanty, on the authority of Ali ibn Ja’far that he had heard Abal-Hassan Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim (MGB) say,

“One day when God’s Prophet (MGB) was sitting an angel who had twenty-four faces came down. The Prophet (MGB) said, ‘O my friend Gabriel! I have never seen you in this state.’ The angel said, ‘I am not Gabriel. I am Mahmood. The Honorable the Exalted God has sent me down to unite in marriage one light with another light.’ The Prophet (MGB) asked, ‘Who are they (to be united?)’ The angel replied, ‘Fatimah (MGB) with Ali (MGB).’ When the angel turned back, it was written in between his two shoulders, ‘Muhammad is God’s Prophet (MGB) and Ali (MGB) is his Trustee.’ God’s Prophet (MGB) asked, ‘Since when has this been written in between your two shoulders?’ The angel replied, ‘From twenty-two thousand years before the Honorable the Exalted God created Adam.’”
